about: Drawing output of demos/camera-lasers at commit f04c973 (v0.1.21 wip), before its model returned its picture as shared/graphics.js data (owner decision D2, 2026-10-22), recorded in Node by running that commit's page code (main.js draw/body with the Manipulate call stubbed; the browser's Math.sin/cos may differ in the last bit). Per state: steps = the setState/loadState partials applied from the initial state; graphics = the Graphics data drawn, as the hook window.__demo.graphics(k) copies them (cachedGraphics parts expanded into "thunk", Raw parts as {"head":"Raw"}); state = the Manipulate variables afterwards; model = the model's own drawing format the page drew from. Machine doubles as JSON (-0 written as 0).
